domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. Tofler company page returned HTTP 404 at the guessed CIN path; Zauba Corp and TheCompanyCheck returned HTTP 403; Eximpedia and Trademo returned HTTP 403; ImportGenius served a JavaScript challenge. Registered address visible on ImportKey: "133, B R B BOSE ROAD N/A". No domestic supply record seen.
note: Rule 5 applied strictly: the customs evidence proves the company is an active, high-volume importer of cadmium, selenium and other minor metals (Glencore, Nyrstar, Nexa Resources, Mitsui Kinzoku as suppliers; 14 counterparties, 22 port lanes), but it does NOT prove any export shipment. No export record with date, destination, HS code and B/L number was found, so export_status = none_found rather than declared_only. Domestic supply likewise unverified — no GST band or tender data was publicly retrievable, so domestic_status = unknown, not confirmed. Declared HS codes 282090 / 720211 / 720229 / 720230 (manganese oxides, ferromanganese, ferrosilicon-manganese) do not match the observed trade lines, which are 28049000 (selenium) and 81126910 (cadmium) — on the import side. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the HS field should be corrected to the actually observed codes if the company is retained. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source reached. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down for the whole session (connection refused), so no web_search corroboration was possible; findings rest solely on the ImportKey free view. Tool budget: 10 calls used.
